_meta.description: Curated pre-2024 concordance for CrimeGPT cross-references. Keys are the NEW-law (act, section_code) as stored in this system's corpus (data/bns_bnss_bsa/*_sections.json); values are the corresponding pre-2024 provision. This is a fixed published mapping (BNS<->IPC, BNSS<->CrPC, BSA<->Indian Evidence Act 1872), NOT inferred. Where a BNS/BNSS/BSA section maps to a cluster of old sections, the single most representative (usually punishment) provision is given. Genuinely new offences with no pre-2024 predecessor (e.g. BNS 304 Snatching) are intentionally ABSENT and fall back to the AI-suggested path.
